title: @catherinee.md — LilyGO T-Display S3 keychain mini-display
note: @catherinee.md's LilyGO T-Display S3 (ESP32) keychain mini-display reel: a keychain loaded with a custom text loop, a song visualiser, Halloween and koi animations and a usage meter, controlled by a phone app, with an NFC sticker on the back linking to her portfolio. Flagged October 30 as a side project to try: her version could run her own drawn animations and motifs and a music visualiser.
